title: Merchandise
slide_intent: Distinguish between applying a mark to goods and directing someone to an official source. A reader needs to know which of those actions the book describes.
strategic_value: Slack can identify its own branded products as a distinct channel in this edition’s policy.
demonstration: Two short clauses address use of Slack assets on goods and point to the Slack Shop. No merchandise specimen appears on the page.
practical_value: Use these clauses to locate the 2020 position on merchandise, rather than treating the page as a visual specification for producing an item.

content_islands.name: Merchandise provisions
content_islands.spec: Place the two lettered clauses together in a narrow left column beneath the title rule. Keep the reference to the official shop with the second clause.

content_islands.name: Open field and folio
content_islands.spec: Keep the remaining page free of merchandise mockups. Finish with the governance footer.
